description.value:
You've trained to shift your combat approach in the middle of a fight. This feature offers three effects — Change Up, Draw, and Stow — and each time you use Adaptive Fighting you pick which one to trigger.

You have two uses of this feature, gaining one more at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. All expended uses return after a short or long rest.

Change Up. Using your object interaction for the turn, you can spend a use of Adaptive Fighting to swap out the Fighting Style granted by your fighter class feature for a different one.

Draw. When your object interaction is spent drawing one or more weapons, you can spend a use of Adaptive Fighting, requiring no action, to widen your critical hit range by 1 with those weapons until the start of your next turn.

Stow. When your object interaction is spent sheathing or holstering a weapon, you can spend a use of Adaptive Fighting, requiring no action, to also take the Disengage action.
